description: Hand-authored policy facts and claims for the RAGForge NLI dataset. Each fact names its decisive evidence with exact quotes from one section; each claim is [label, phenomenon, text, why] plus optional {"q": [quotes], "scoped": true}. Labels: S = SUPPORTED, C = CONTRADICTED, I = INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. A claim's label must hold both against its decisive sentence(s) alone and against the full section. src/nli_dataset.py derives evidence formats and extra examples from this file.

authoring.method: Written by hand from data/documents/ text while implementing M6.2 (drafted with Claude Code). No model output was used to write or adjust labels.
conventions: A claim that states a different value for a threshold, deadline, limit or approver that the evidence defines for the same rule is CONTRADICTED (consistent with the M5 verifier definitions).
Numeric contradictions are written in the direction that cannot be logically implied by the evidence (more lenient deadlines, higher permissions, different exact values).
A claim about a group or policy the evidence does not cover is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never CONTRADICTED.
Claims marked scoped name their group explicitly, so they can be paired with a sibling policy's evidence as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

Counterpart pairing is directional: a fact's scoped claims are paired with a sibling fact's evidence only when that evidence sentence names its own group explicitly (a universally worded sentence inside a group-specific policy could otherwise read as support or contradiction).

Facts marked sentence_context have a decisive sentence whose subject is only identified by the surrounding section; they get no sentence-format example, because the lone sentence would not establish the claim's scope.

F01-refunds.why: Near-duplicate domestic and international refund policies.

F06-expenses.why: Travel and non-travel expense claims share 30-day deadlines and $25 receipt rules.

F07-purchasing.why: Purchase, card and budget approval thresholds; FIN-204 restates FIN-202's $1,000 threshold.

F09-leave.why: Annual and parental leave notice and accrual rules.

F10-workplace.why: Remote work restates onboarding's first 4 weeks on-site.

F12-authentication.why: Passwords and MFA cross-reference each other.

F14-incidents.why: SEC-305 restates SEC-304's 1-hour reporting rule for lost devices.
